question: What does a tiny seed need from the sky to grow? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! Seeds need warm sunlight and water to wake up and grow! ☀️
hint: It shines bright during the day.

question: What do we call a cute baby dog? 🐶
explanation: Great job! A baby dog is called a sweet little puppy! 🐶
hint: It goes woof-woof!

question: What does a baby frog look like? 🐸
explanation: Super! A baby frog is a tiny tadpole that swims in water! 🐸
hint: It has a long tail to swim.

question: What does a butterfly grow from? 🦋
explanation: Awesome! A hungry caterpillar eats leaves and turns into a beautiful butterfly! 🦋
hint: It crawls and eats lots of leaves.

question: Which season has bright and colorful blooming flowers? 🌸
explanation: Great job! Spring is the lovely season when new flowers bloom everywhere! 🌸
hint: It comes after the cold winter.

question: Where do plant roots grow to find water? 🌱
explanation: Super! Roots grow deep underground in the soil to drink up water! 🌱
hint: It is beneath our feet.

question: What does a fluffy yellow chick hatch from? 🐣
explanation: Awesome! A mother hen keeps her egg warm until a little chick hatches! 🐣
hint: It is white and breaks open.

question: Which season brings cold weather and warm sweaters? ❄️
explanation: Great job! Winter is cold, so we wear warm clothes and drink hot cocoa! ❄️
hint: You might see snow in this season.

question: What do we call a playful baby cat? 🐱
explanation: Super! A little baby cat is called a fluffy kitten! 🐱
hint: It loves to purr and meow.

question: What do mother birds build to keep their babies safe? 🪹
explanation: Awesome! Birds use twigs and leaves to build cozy nests for their eggs! 🪹
hint: You can find it high up in a tree.

question: Which plant part stands up tall and straight? 🎋
explanation: Great job! The stem acts like a strong pillar to hold the plant up! 🎋
hint: It carries water from the roots up to the leaves.

question: Which green part of a plant makes food using sunlight? 🍃
explanation: Super! Green leaves are like tiny kitchens that make food for the whole plant! 🍃
hint: They change colors and fall in autumn.

question: What is a baby cow called? 🐮
explanation: Awesome! A little baby cow is known as a calf! 🐮
hint: It drinks milk from its mother.

question: Where does a seed sleep before it starts growing? 🌱
explanation: Great job! Seeds sleep safely in the soft soil until they get water and sun! 🌱
hint: It is brown and covers the ground.

question: What drops down from dark gray clouds? 🌧️
explanation: Super! Rain brings fresh water down to the earth so plants can drink! 🌧️
hint: You need an umbrella when this happens.

question: Which season gives us lots of puddles to jump in? 🌧️
explanation: Awesome! The Monsoon season brings heavy rain and makes everything green! 🌧️
hint: We wear raincoats during this time.

question: What pretty and sweet-smelling thing grows on a plant? 🌸
explanation: Great job! Beautiful flowers bloom and attract bees and butterflies! 🌸
hint: Roses and sunflowers are examples.

question: What is a fluffy little baby bird called? 🐥
explanation: Super! A baby bird that hatches from an egg is called a chick! 🐥
hint: It goes peep-peep!

question: What do we call a brave baby lion? 🦁
explanation: Awesome! A strong little baby lion is known as a cub! 🦁
hint: It will grow up to be the king of the jungle.

question: Which yummy plant part do we love to eat? 🍎
explanation: Great job! Plants give us tasty and healthy fruits like apples and mangoes! 🍎
hint: It is juicy and sweet.

question: What is a very big, tall, and strong plant called? 🌳
explanation: Super! Trees grow huge and strong, providing shade and fresh air for us! 🌳
hint: It has branches and a thick trunk.

question: What is a cute baby duck called? 🦆
explanation: Awesome! A little yellow duck that swims in the pond is a duckling! 🦆
hint: It follows its mother and says quack!

question: What do we call a very soft baby sheep? 🐑
explanation: Great job! A soft and woolly baby sheep is called a lamb! 🐑
hint: It says baa-baa!

question: What is a jumpy little baby goat called? 🐐
explanation: Super! A fun and bouncy baby goat is called a kid! 🐐
hint: It has tiny little horns growing.

question: In which season do dry leaves fall from trees? 🍂
explanation: Awesome! During Autumn, tree leaves turn brown and gently fall to the ground! 🍂
hint: It is also known as Fall.

question: What big yellow star gives us light in the daytime? ☀️
explanation: Great job! The bright Sun gives plants and animals the warmth they need to grow! ☀️
hint: It rises every morning.

question: What cool drink do plant roots soak up from the ground? 💧
explanation: Super! Roots act like tiny straws that drink up water from the damp soil! 💧
hint: It is clear and we drink it too.

question: What is a brand new tiny plant called? 🌱
explanation: Awesome! When a seed first sprouts, it becomes a cute little seedling! 🌱
hint: It is very small and delicate.

question: What do we call a fast little baby horse? 🐴
explanation: Great job! A fast-running baby horse is known as a foal! 🐴
hint: It has long legs and loves to run.

question: What is a pink and playful baby pig called? 🐷
explanation: Super! A cute little baby pig is called a piglet! 🐷
hint: It loves to roll in the mud.

question: What soft coat keeps animals warm in the winter? 🐕
explanation: Awesome! Thick and cozy fur protects animals from freezing cold weather! 🐕
hint: Dogs and bears have lots of it.

question: Which hot season is perfect for eating sweet ice cream? ☀️
explanation: Great job! Summer is very hot, so cold ice cream and swimming feel amazing! ☀️
hint: The sun shines the brightest during this time.

question: What sweet juice do butterflies sip from flowers? 🌸
explanation: Super! Butterflies use their long tongues to drink yummy nectar from flowers! 🌸
hint: It is sweet like sugar.

question: What do we call a heavy baby elephant? 🐘
explanation: Awesome! Even though it is big, a baby elephant is still called a calf! 🐘
hint: It has a small trunk and big ears.

question: Where does a wiggly tadpole love to swim? 💧
explanation: Great job! Tadpoles live and swim in cool water until they grow into frogs! 💧
hint: It fills up ponds and lakes.

question: What sweet food do busy buzzing bees make? 🍯
explanation: Super! Bees collect nectar and turn it into golden, delicious honey! 🍯
hint: It is sticky and very sweet.

question: What is a furry little baby bear called? 🐻
explanation: Awesome! A little baby bear is known as a fuzzy cub! 🐻
hint: It loves to eat berries and fish.

question: Which beautiful plant part eventually turns into a fruit? 🌺
explanation: Great job! As nature changes, pretty flowers grow and turn into yummy fruits! 🌺
hint: It has colorful petals.

question: What soft covering helps birds fly in the sky? 🪶
explanation: Super! Light and smooth feathers help birds stay warm and fly high! 🪶
hint: They come in many colors and are very light.

question: What parts help a fish swim quickly in the water? 🐟
explanation: Awesome! Fish use their strong fins and tail to glide through the water safely! 🐟
hint: They wiggle back and forth on the sides of a fish.

question: What is a hungry caterpillar's favorite food? 🍃
explanation: Great job! Caterpillars chomp and chew on fresh green leaves to grow big! 🍃
hint: They grow on the branches of trees.

question: What natural items do birds mostly use to make their nests? 🪵
explanation: Super! Birds are great builders, weaving twigs and dry grass into snug nests! 🪵
hint: They are tiny broken branches from trees.

question: What do we call a gentle baby deer? 🦌
explanation: Awesome! A little baby deer with white spots is called a fawn! 🦌
hint: It runs very fast in the forest.

question: What do we call the daily change between sunny, rainy, or cloudy outside? ⛅
explanation: Great job! The weather changes every day, giving us sunshine, rain, or wind! ⛅
hint: You check it before deciding what to wear outside.

question: Which magical little bug lights up brightly in the night sky? ✨
explanation: Super! A firefly glows in the dark and looks like a tiny flying star! ✨
hint: It has a blinking yellow light on its tail.

question: Where does a caterpillar hide safely while turning into a butterfly? 🐛
explanation: Awesome! A caterpillar wraps itself in a snug cocoon to grow its beautiful wings! 🐛
hint: It hangs from a branch like a little sleeping bag.

question: What unseen thing does nature give us so we can breathe deeply? 💨
explanation: Great job! Trees give us clean, fresh air so we can breathe easily and stay healthy! 💨
hint: You can feel it blow like a breeze but cannot see it.

question: What is a striped baby tiger called? 🐯
explanation: Super! A little baby tiger with orange and black stripes is called a cub! 🐯
hint: It will grow up to have a loud roar.

question: What body part helps strong birds fly across the sky? 🦅
explanation: Awesome! Birds flap their large wings to lift off the ground and fly high! 🦅
hint: Airplanes have them too.

question: What hard cover protects a sleeping seed until it is ready to grow? 🌰
explanation: Great job! The tough seed coat acts like armor to keep the baby plant inside safe! 🌰
hint: It is like a tiny jacket for the seed.
